about: Registry of promotion items (Constitution §3B, §6): published DEV articles and awesome-list PRs. tools/devto.mjs registers DEV articles; tools/metrics.mjs snapshots every item into history/metrics/channels.csv.

fields.url: public URL of the article or PR
fields.devto_id: DEV article ID (type devto only; set by tools/devto.mjs)
fields.promo: path of the promotion package, e.g. history/promo/earnstar_1/O-003-devto/
